protos.name: Essay
rationale: One serif column at about 68 characters, the way long essays are read on paper.
Deep dives float into the right margin on wide screens (Tufte-style sidenotes) and sit inline on phones.
Nothing competes with the text: no cards, one quiet blue for links.
protos.type: Source Serif 4 (text and display), JetBrains Mono (code only)
protos.brand: Dark mode uses the landing page's #0A0A0F ground; same dr4w wordmark and author link.
protos.weakest: The quietest home page of the ten; with only one issue it relies on the writing to hold attention.

protos.name: Swiss grid
rationale: A strict 12-column grid with one grotesk; hierarchy comes from scale and position, not decoration.
Huge tight headlines, a sticky contents rail on the left, thick black rules as section markers.
Ends on a full-width wordmark, like a poster.
protos.brand: Black/white with one red; dark mode on #0A0A0F; the oversized dr4w wordmark echoes the landing hero name.
protos.weakest: Huge grotesk headlines make long section titles wrap; titles must stay short.

protos.name: Engineer's notebook
rationale: A humanist sans with a thick red margin rule, like a lab notebook.
Deep dives become annotations in the left margin, beside the paragraph they belong to.
Feels like working notes written up properly: friendly, technical, unpretentious.
protos.type: Hanken Grotesk (text and headings), JetBrains Mono (code only)
protos.brand: Teal accent sits next to the landing page's cyan; dark mode keeps the near-black ground.
protos.weakest: Margin annotations need a wide screen; below 62 rem they become ordinary boxes.

protos.name: Longform magazine
rationale: A cover-sized issue number opens each issue, then a drop cap and a serif column.
Analogies become pull quotes that break out of the column; every figure runs full-bleed on a colour field.
Deep dives are boxed sidebars hanging into the right margin.
protos.type: Fraunces (display), Source Serif 4 (text), JetBrains Mono (code only)
protos.brand: The issue number plays the role the name plays on dr4w.io's hero; dark mode on #0A0A0F.
protos.weakest: Three typefaces (display, text, code) and full-bleed figures make it the heaviest to maintain.

protos.name: Monochrome + one accent
rationale: Black and white only; the dr4w cyan appears on links and focus rings and nowhere else.
A sticky contents column on desktop, heavy sans headlines, analogies set as inverted black blocks.
Figures render in pure ink, so the diagrams read like technical drawings.
protos.brand: Uses the landing page's exact cyan (#00D9FF on dark) as its only colour, and the dr4w. wordmark with a cyan dot.
protos.weakest: Monochrome figures lose the one highlight colour that helps diagrams read.

protos.name: Book
rationale: Garamond, indented paragraphs instead of spaced ones, a sticky italic running head with the issue title.
Each issue opens like a chapter, centred; the home page is a title page and a contents list.
Print proportions: a narrow text block and generous margins.
protos.brand: Weakest visual tie to dr4w.io by design; shares the dark ground and the wordmark only.
protos.weakest: Centred openings and indented paragraphs read as print; the home page is sparse until there are many issues.

protos.name: Research paper
rationale: Figure-first: diagrams run wider than the text with their captions beside them on large screens.
Opens with title, author, an abstract and keywords; deep dives are boxes, as in a journal; notes become References.
A serif for reading and a sans for every interface label and figure.
protos.type: Literata (text), Inter (labels, figures, UI), JetBrains Mono (code only)
protos.brand: Inter is the landing page's body face; dark mode on #0A0A0F.
protos.weakest: The abstract and boxed asides make it feel formal; figure captions beside figures need 72 rem.

protos.name: Warm paper
rationale: A soft stone-grey ground with deep green ink: warm without the beige-and-orange cliché.
Relaxed leading, rounded surfaces, a collapsible contents box; everything at reading pace.
The calmest of the ten.
protos.brand: Deliberately quieter than dr4w.io; connects through the wordmark and the author link.
protos.weakest: Soft contrast on surfaces and rounded panels can read as generic; weakest tie to the dr4w brand.

protos.name: Dark-first editorial
rationale: Continuity with dr4w.io: the same #0A0A0F ground, Space Grotesk headlines, Inter text and the violet accent, set for long reading.
A sticky 'on this page' rail, figures on raised surfaces, a giant 'Writing' masthead.
Light mode is the variant, not the default.
protos.type: Space Grotesk (headings), Inter (text), JetBrains Mono (code only)
protos.brand: Strongest link: same ground, fonts, violet accent and the dr4w.io wordmark with a coloured dot.
protos.weakest: Uses the violet the design gate flags as an AI-site tell (allowed only as the brand colour).

protos.name: Index-first
rationale: The home page is the table of contents: each issue's huge number, title, summary and every section, linked.
Article pages are deliberately quiet: modest title, narrow column, no chrome.
Scales well as issues accumulate.
protos.brand: Big numerals mirror the issue-number URLs; dark mode on #0A0A0F; green accent is its own.
protos.weakest: Article pages are deliberately plain; the design shines only once there are several issues.

rankingBy: Chosen at gate G1 by Daniel Baumann on 2026-10-15. The other nine are kept as a reference.

ranking.name: Essay (p01): chosen
ranking.reason: One serif column with margin notes; Lighthouse 100 on every category, 0 axe violations, 0 taste-skill FAIL. Became the site; rules in docs/design-system.md.
